verdict.rationale: Vanta documents a broad first-party API surface. The Manage Vanta API lists documents, policies, and evidence, and supports create, update, and deactivate on controls. It also covers uploading and deleting contracts, listing tests, assigning control owners, attaching evidence, business units, and Customer Trust questionnaire responses. Beyond that, there is a full Auditor API with SDKs, webhooks, and an MCP server that acts on compliance data. Nothing in the pack claims UI parity, and many UI product areas have no API endpoints in the evidence: Trust Center, access reviews, risk management, TPRM, and AI agent workflows. No public OpenAPI spec was found by the probe. missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity statement, API coverage of Trust Center, access reviews, risk and vendor management, a published OpenAPI spec, independent hands-on confirmation of coverage.
